value.rationale: The exact boundary answers a natural failure of the source extrema-based extinction test: the disease is cleared on every ecological cycle for all transmission up to and including the baseline static threshold, regardless of cycle amplitude. The per-cycle strictly larger sharp invasion boundary and mechanistic variance formula are meaningful epidemiological thresholds, not merely a local perturbation or arbitrary parameter table.
